description: Dan Dan Noodles Sichuan is a beloved street food classic from Sichuan province, China. This dish features chewy noodles coated in a rich, spicy, and savory sauce, topped with crispy minced pork and fresh greens. It offers a delightful symphony of flavors, from fiery chili oil to nutty sesame paste, making it an unforgettable culinary experience.

ingredients.item: Chinese egg noodles or fresh wheat noodles
Bok choy or other green leafy vegetables

instructions.title: Prepare the Aromatic Sauce Base
instructions.text: In each of four serving bowls, combine 1-1.5 tablespoons chili oil, 1 tablespoon light soy sauce, 1/2 tablespoon Chinkiang black vinegar, 1/2 tablespoon sesame paste, 1/4 teaspoon Sichuan peppercorn powder, 1/4 teaspoon sugar, and a quarter of the minced garlic. Stir well to form a thick, fragrant sauce at the bottom of each bowl.

instructions.title: Cook the Minced Pork Topping
instructions.text: Heat 1 tablespoon cooking oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the minced pork and stir-fry, breaking it apart, until it is cooked through and lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess fat. Add the minced ginger and the remaining minced garlic, stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the chopped Ya Cai and continue to cook for another 2-3 minutes until heated through and well combined. Set aside.

instructions.title: Blanch the Greens
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add the bok choy or other greens and blanch for 1-2 minutes until tender-crisp. Remove with tongs or a slotted spoon and set aside. Keep the boiling water for the noodles.

instructions.title: Cook the Noodles
instructions.text: In the same pot of boiling water, add the fresh or dried noodles. Cook according to package instructions until al dente. For fresh noodles, this usually takes 2-4 minutes. For dried noodles, it might be 5-8 minutes. Ensure they are chewy but not mushy.

instructions.title: Assemble the Dan Dan Noodles
instructions.text: Once the noodles are cooked, quickly drain them. Immediately divide the hot noodles among the four prepared serving bowls, placing them directly over the sauce base. Arrange the blanched greens on top of the noodles.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve
instructions.text: Spoon a generous portion of the cooked minced pork and Ya Cai mixture over the noodles and greens in each bowl. Garnish with chopped scallions and crushed roasted peanuts. Serve immediately, instructing diners to toss everything together thoroughly before eating to coat the noodles evenly with the flavorful sauce.

tips: Always use fresh, high-quality Sichuan peppercorns and grind them just before use for the most potent numbing and fragrant 'ma la' sensation.

If you cannot find Ya Cai (Sichuan preserved vegetables), you can substitute with finely chopped preserved mustard greens or even finely diced pickled radish, though the flavor profile will be slightly different.
For the best texture, serve Dan Dan Noodles immediately after assembly. The noodles can absorb the sauce quickly, so tossing and eating without delay is key.
